From the recurrence,
\[
x_{i+1}=\frac{x_i+1}{5-3x_i}.
\]
Define
\[
z_i=\frac{x_i-1}{x_i-\frac13}.
\]
Then
\[
z_{i+1}=2z_i,
\]
so
\[
z_{43}=2^{42}z_1.
\]
Since \(x_1=x_{43}\), we have \(z_1=z_{43}\), hence
\[
(2^{42}-1)z_1=0.
\]
Thus \(z_1=0\) or \(z_1=\infty\), giving \(x_1=1\) or \(x_1=\frac13\). The sequence is constant in each case.

So the possible sums are
\[
42\cdot 1=42 \quad \text{and} \quad 42\cdot \frac13=14.
\]
Their product is
\[
42\cdot 14=588.
\]

\[
\boxed{588}
\]
